newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran arrests 53 weapon smugglers in oil province.
newsitem.headline: Iran arrests 53 weapon smugglers in oil province.

text.p: Police in Iran's oil-rich Khuzestan province have broken up 16 arms smuggling rings and arrested 53 traffickers, a senior security official said on Tuesday.
The Iranian news agency IRNA quoted the province's top security official, identified only as Mehrab, as saying agents also seized 128 weapons.
He did not say when the arrests were made and did not specify the types of weapons.

Iran said last week it had arrested two Iraqis and two Iranians in the southwesten province on charges of spying for Iraq and trying to smuggle out members of the Iraq-based Mujahideen Khalq armed opposition group.
The Mujahideen denied last week's report and said its forces had clashed with government troops in Khuzestan and areas in western and southern Iran.
